<p>“Then… please be careful, Hunter Yoon Seong-hyeon.”</p><p>“Yes.”</p><p>As usual, I pulled a cart loaded with lunchboxes toward the Gate. The Hunter Association employees who always helped unload the containers at the Gate had become familiar faces after seeing them for so long.</p><p>Just as I was heading toward the Gate, a man in a suit came sprinting from afar, his face pale.</p><p>“Hunter Yoon Seong-hyeon, please—just a moment! Wait for me!”</p><p>“Huh?”</p><p>The man had been running at full speed, so he was panting heavily as he approached me.</p><p>As I stood there in confusion, he glanced around before leaning in and whispering,</p><p>“I thought something had happened since you weren’t answering your phone.”</p><p>“Huh? What’s going on?”</p><p>I checked my phone and realized I had it on silent. There were seven missed calls from an unknown number.</p><p>“Ah, sorry. I had it on silent. Is there a problem?”</p><p>My heart started pounding, and a wave of unease washed over me.</p><p>Looking closely, the ashen-faced man was Han Ji-hyeok’s aide—someone I’d seen multiple times at the Central Headquarters.</p><p>He probably knew that Han Ji-hyeok was planning to involve Echo in the Daemado subjugation.</p><p>Once the man caught his breath, he continued,</p><p>“The monsters on Daemado have started moving.”</p><p>“Where to?”</p><p>“Jeju Island…”</p><p>“What?!”</p><p>My loud exclamation drew the attention of the other Association members nearby.</p><p>“Then what do we do?”</p><p>‘Come to think of it, if it’s Jeju Island, there should still be plenty of time before they reach Seoul…’</p><p>I was having a rather selfish thought when the Association employee spoke quietly,</p><p>“This will be announced nationwide by this afternoon. For now, Jeju Island residents will be evacuated to the mainland. All Korean and Japanese Hunters participating in the Daemado subjugation will gather in Korea to intercept the monsters at Jeju Island.”</p><p>“How long until the monsters reach Jeju Island?”</p><p>“They’re predicted to land in 70 hours. Daemado is already empty. Every single monster there is heading straight for Jeju Island.”</p><p>“···.”</p><p>I was so stunned I couldn’t even speak.</p><p>But one thing was now certain.</p><p>As many had already suspected, there was definitely a leading entity controlling the monster horde on Daemado.</p><p>The Demon Island was covered by a special barrier created by the monsters, making it nearly impossible to observe the interior even by satellite. However, the estimated number of monsters on the island was around 60,000 to 70,000.</p><p>If that many monsters were moving toward Jeju Island all at once, there had to be a leader controlling the horde.</p><p>‘Do I really have to immigrate…?’</p><p>The man looked at me with desperate eyes.</p><p>“The Association President said this is shameless of him to ask, but he desperately needs Echo-nim’s help.”</p><p>“Huuu…”</p><p>After apologizing to the Association member, I set down the cart and went to a secluded area to call Yu-na first.</p><p>In a few hours, the current situation would be announced nationwide anyway, so I explained everything to Yu-na and told her I would try to persuade Echo over the remaining 70 hours.</p><p>Yu-na understood without much difficulty.</p><p>Couples who had Hunters as partners rarely panicked over ordinary matters.</p><p>After ending the call, I returned to the man and said,</p><p>“I’ll try to persuade him over the next 70 hours. If it doesn’t work, I’ll come back then.”</p><p>“Yes, thank you. Thank you so much…”</p><p>The man bowed deeply, his waist bending nearly 180 degrees, as if begging me.</p><p>I felt like a heavy weight had settled on my shoulders.</p><p>***</p><p>Whoosh</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="291338" loading="lazy">
</p><p>“Has the Master arrived?”</p><p>“Yeah.”</p><p>As I pulled the cart through the gate, Yuria, who had come to greet me in advance, welcomed me with a smile.</p><p>Perhaps the Association members had already been informed, as everyone’s faces were filled with unease.</p><p>“I’ll carry the luggage.”</p><p>“Thanks. By the way, do you think I could meet His Majesty right now?”</p><p>“Ah…”</p><p>Yuria stopped walking and replied,</p><p>“His Majesty is currently at the main palace and won’t return until tomorrow.”</p><p>“Huh?”</p><p>My mind grew complicated. At least 24 of the remaining 70 hours had just vanished.</p><p>Noticing my serious expression, Yuria asked with concern,</p><p>“Master, do you have any troubles?”</p><p>“Yeah. It’s just…”</p><p>I laid out the entire situation for Yuria. She seemed to already know about the support I had mentioned to Echo, as she nodded in understanding.</p><p>“Master, does that mean you’ll be intercepting the enemies on that island called Jeju?”</p><p>“Yeah, I didn’t hear the details, but that’s the plan, apparently.”</p><p>“Then what happens to the humans who lived there?”</p><p>“They said they’re evacuating them to the mainland first.”</p><p>To Yuria, this was just talk about a different species from another world, so she didn’t react with any particular surprise and spoke as usual.</p><p>‘Well… it’s a big deal for the humans, I guess.’</p><p>For now, all I could do was stay put here and wait for Echo to return until tomorrow.</p><p>“Then I’ll prepare Master’s meal. His Majesty said to carry on as usual, so please make yourself comfortable.”</p><p>“Mm…”</p><p>After returning to my room and unpacking, I flopped down onto the bed.</p><p>No one outside would ever imagine I was lying here in bed right now.</p><p>Headquarters and the committee were in full panic mode, scrambling to mobilize Hunters, hastily drafting plans, and preparing to head to Jeju Island.</p><p>‘I *am* doing my best, though…’</p><p>As I lay on the bed, sighing repeatedly, Yuria’s voice came from outside the door.</p><p>“Master. Dinner is ready, so please come out when you’re ready.”</p><p>“Yeah.”</p><p>Outside, hell would break loose in 69 hours, yet here I was, living in luxury like some noble.</p><p>Honestly, I’d even considered that if my request for support got rejected, I’d just take Yu-na and my family and flee overseas.</p><p>There was no law saying we couldn’t come back to the mainland after going to Jeju…</p><p>My guess was that the reason they were coming to Jeju in the first place was to seek out more fertile land.</p><p>They might even build up their forces there and then invade the Korean mainland.</p><p>With Echo away, the only person sitting at the dinner table was me.</p><p>Yuria was still serving the food neatly onto my plate as always, but there was one difference from usual.</p><p>Beside Yuria, who was transferring side dishes, there was a fourth presence I hadn’t seen before—after Echo, Nerus, and Yuria.</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="291339" loading="lazy"></p><p>When I glanced at Yuria, she seemed to read my mind and began explaining the new presence beside her.</p><p>“Ah, Master. This one is a steward from another fortress. She’s here temporarily due to some circumstances.”</p><p>Unlike Yuria’s cold demeanor, this succubus had horns that were openly flickering with small flames.</p><p>“Greetings. I am Cecilia, who will be serving His Majesty in this castle for the time being.”</p><p>“Y-Yes… Hello.”</p><p>“Master, there’s no need to speak formally to Cecilia either.”</p><p>“R-Right…”</p><p>After greeting me politely, Cecilia stared at me from the corner of the room with a meaningful look in her eyes.</p><p>‘Is she curious about humans?’</p><p>***</p><p>After finishing my meal, I returned to my room and sat on the bed, agonizing over and over about what to say to Echo when I saw him tomorrow.</p><p>The best chance would be to bring it up when he was in a good mood, and since he’d probably eat as soon as he arrived tomorrow, that seemed like the right time.</p><p>Another piece of good news was that I’d heard Nerus would be coming with Echo tomorrow.</p><p>‘If I can just take Nerus back with me, things will be a lot easier.’</p><p>As I ran through every possible scenario in my head, a knock came at the door, followed by Yuria’s voice.</p><p>“Master, may I come in?”</p><p>“Yeah.”</p><p>I’d probably end up having sex with Yuria tonight. If the Association saw me now, they’d faint in shock, but there was nothing I could do about it.</p><p>‘They wouldn’t understand a master’s duties or anything like that anyway…’</p><p>Even if I returned tomorrow, I didn’t plan on telling the Association that Echo had been gone for an extra day.</p><p>If the support was approved, I’d just play it off like I’d spent the whole night exhausting myself trying to persuade him.</p><p>Squeak</p><p>The door opened, and Yuria entered.</p><p>“Yeah, sit here. Huh?”</p><p>Then, following Yuria, Cecilia came in as well.</p><p>“Yuria?”</p><p>As I stared at Yuria in confusion, she and Cecilia both bowed politely to me.</p><p>I sat there, dumbfounded, and Yuria began speaking with a very serious expression.</p><p>“Master. There is something I must humbly request of you.”</p><p>“Yeah, go ahead…”</p><p>It was obvious this had something to do with Cecilia beside her.</p><p>With the heart-shaped tail swaying behind her and horns nearly identical to Yuria’s, Cecilia was clearly a succubus. I was curious what she could possibly want from me.</p><p>‘I thought she was gonna suggest a threesome and I almost panicked, but nope… thank god.’</p><p>Yuria was already more than enough—I didn’t have the confidence to handle Cecilia on top of that.</p><p>Yuria cleared her throat, then spoke with a face full of worry.</p><p>“Could you perhaps hold Cecilia for me?”</p><p>“Huh?”</p><p>‘A threesome might be the way to go.’</p><p>***</p><p>“I see, so that’s how it is…”</p><p>What Yuria said was this:</p><p>Apparently, the succubus race originally replenished their mana by exchanging it with their kin in a unique way.</p><p>Because the mana given to another would return even greater than what was given. If that wasn’t possible, then the alternative was to exchange mana through sex.</p><p>Sex for reproduction was socially taboo unless it was between engaged partners, so the remaining option was to do it the human way.</p><p>The problem was… Cecilia was born with a constitution that caused an adverse reaction to receiving mana from her own kind.</p><p>Because of that, she couldn’t receive mana through any method, and the only remaining option was natural mana recovery—which was apparently horrendously inefficient.</p><p>She said that to simply fill the amount of mana exchanged between kin through natural recovery would take about a month.</p><p>“But… I’m human, and I don’t even have mana. Would doing it with me actually fill it up?”</p><p>Yuria nodded and said,</p><p>“Yes. I only realized this after sleeping with you, Master. We can obtain mana through sex with humans too. The vital energy that flows from you enters our bodies and converts into mana. The quantity is also enormous—it’s almost as efficient as exchanging with our own kind.”</p><p>“Hmm…”</p><p>I scratched my head and asked Cecilia,</p><p>“Uh… would that be okay with you, Cecilia? From what I’m hearing, it sounds like you don’t have any experience. Would you be fine with your first time being with a human?”</p><p>Cecilia answered with a face full of determination.</p><p>“Yes! If it can resolve the current situation, it would be an honor. I’ll do my best!”</p><p>“···.”</p><p>As I silently nodded, Yuria flicked her fingers, and Cecilia’s clothes vanished like smoke.</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="291340" loading="lazy">
</p><p>“Eek! Yuria-nim?!”</p><p>Cecilia’s body was the opposite of Yuria’s. If Yuria was the epitome of voluptuousness, dripping with honeyed allure, then Cecilia gave off a slightly slender impression…</p><p>And seeing how excessively shy she was for a succubus, that very shyness seemed to add to her charm—so much so that my dick hardened in an instant.</p>
